items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: My mother's name was Susie, and her maiden name was Garrett.

ctx.x: My mother's name was Susie, and her maiden name was Garrett. She was born -- and my dad, were born down around Franklin, Louisiana, around Sheraton, and my mother was born in Sheraton and my father was born in Franklin, Louisiana, I think a little town out from Franklin known as St. Joseph. That's where their roots are.
Did your -- was your father's family and your mother's family also musical?
